pages.why: Specifies the quantity of Filter Backwash Pumps under the Pre-Treatment Plant scope of supply.
P&ID for Pre-Treatment Plant shows the Filter Backwash Transfer Pumps and their quantity.
Datasheet A for Pre-Treatment Plant specifies the quantity, type, and capacity of Gravity Filter Back wash water pumps.

values.quote: 11.1.30 Three (3) nos. Filter Backwash Pumps with piping, valves, fittings and instrumentation up to Stilling Chambers of PT-CW & PT-DM Clarifiers.

values.quote: 19.2 Gravity Filter Back wash water pumps | Two (2X100%) | Vertical sump pump (Suitable to handle Drains with particle size up to 40 mm) | Each pump shall be capable of evacuating the capacity of complete pit within 2 hours.

output.why: The specification documents already disagree on the required number of PT filter backwash pumps, with the scope of supply (Part1.pdf p.85) and P&ID (Part4.pdf p.4) requiring three (3x100%) pumps while Datasheet A (Part4.pdf p.107) specifies two (2x100%) pumps. Furthermore, reducing the count to two directly violates the explicit three-pump requirement in clause 11.1.30 and the P&ID, which provide redundancy to feed backwash water back to both the PT-CW and PT-DM clarifier stilling chambers.
